capabilities: Add RPG Awesome, GovIcons, and Weather Icons iconsets to Obsidian
Toggle each bundled iconset on or off
Use new icons to decorate files, e.g. via the icon field
extras: Each iconset is bundled with the built plugin; listed licenses are SIL OFL 1.1.
intentEvidence: adds additional icons for use anywhere obsidian normally uses the set
motivation: The author uses fileClasses from Metadata Menu to assign icons by file type and wanted more choices than the default Lucide set.
problem: Obsidian ships with only the default Lucide icon set, so users who want themed or domain-specific icons have no built-in options.

relations.evidence: I tend to use a lot of fileClasses from metadata menu, and often use the icon field

summary: Icon pack that adds RPG Awesome, GovIcons, and Weather Icons iconsets for use wherever Obsidian shows icons.
